summary.plain: The KOTO detector is a hermetic calorimeter and veto system in Japan that watches for the tell-tale flash of a neutral kaon decaying into a neutral pion and invisible particles, with nothing else visible.
summary.technical: Hermetic CsI electromagnetic calorimeter with surrounding veto counters at the J-PARC Hadron Experimental Facility, reconstructing KL → π⁰(→γγ) ν ν̄ candidates against visible-particle vetoes.

technology.note: General description of the KOTO technique; the full text of a dedicated detector paper was not consulted, only the official experiment site.
technology.value: Hermetic electromagnetic calorimeter and veto-counter system surrounding a neutral-kaon beamline, reconstructing KL → π⁰ (→ γγ) decays while vetoing all other visible particles
